subject: Pricing follow-up: startup & committed-use options for NovaAI
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@novaai.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing follow-up: startup & committed-use options for NovaAI

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the call today — really enjoyed learning more about NovaAI's ingestion pipeline and the LLM-based summarization feature you plan to ship in Q2. Quick recap and next steps from my side: 

- Rough volumes: you mentioned 20–30M user requests/day with average prompts generating ~400 tokens and completions ~600 tokens (so ~1.6B–4.8B tokens/month depending on usage patterns). You said initial pilot likely ~0.8–1.5B tokens/month. 
- Priority: keep latency under 250ms p95 for inference, and optimize unit economics for high-volume run-rate.
- Current target budget range for pilot: $5k–$10k/month, with larger budgets available for GA if unit economics meet expectations.

Given that, two pricing paths I recommend we evaluate:

1) Startup program (eligible): starter credit + preferential unit pricing for first 6 months to prove economics. Typical structure: $25k credit + up to 50% off unit price for first 6 months (eligibility form attached).
2) Committed-use discounts: tiered discounts at scale — e.g., 3M tokens/month commit (6–12 months) => ~30% off list; 10M+/month commit => 45%+. We can structure multi-year incentives for a larger committed commitment.

To align on numbers we need: a short token-volume forecast (month 1–6) and confirmation of procurement timeline. Could you share a simple estimate (month-by-month) and confirm if NovaAI is a seed-stage startup (for startup program eligibility)? I attached the Startup One-Pager and will follow up with a committed-use draft quote once I have your forecast.

Proposed next steps:
- You: send month-by-month token estimate and confirm startup status / any procurement constraints
- Me: send committed-use quote + an example $/1M token unit economics for the scenarios you shared
- Schedule procurement call with your finance/procurement team (I can do Fri or early next week)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call to walk through the quote.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: Redwood_Startup_OnePager.pdf

From: Olivia Chen <olivia@novaai.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, procurement@novaai.com
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: startup & committed-use options for NovaAI

Thanks Aditya — great summary. A few clarifications and the forecast you asked for below.

Forecast (month-by-month, tokens/month):
- Month 1 (pilot): 0.8B
- Month 2: 1.1B
- Month 3: 1.4B
- Month 4: 1.7B
- Month 5: 2.3B
- Month 6 (GA ramp): 3.8B

We are an early-stage startup (Series A, 25 employees) so interested in startup program credits/discounts. Our current pilot budget is $8k/month; for GA we have flexibility subject to unit economics. Target unit economics we need to hit for internal approval is around $200–$300 per 1M tokens (net price) to keep CAC/LTV targets intact.

Procurement note: we have a standard MSA and prefer 12-month commits for discounts but procurement needs to see an initial quote and SOW.

Happy to schedule a call — procurement@novaai.com can do Monday 10–11am PT.

—Olivia
Olivia Chen
Head of Product | NovaAI
olivia@novaai.com

On Thu, Dec 10, 2026 at 3:10 PM Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Olivia —
> 
> Thanks again for the call today — really enjoyed learning more about NovaAI's ingestion pipeline and the LLM-based summarization feature you plan to ship in Q2. Quick recap and next steps from my side: ...

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@novaai.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, procurement@novaai.com
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 12:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: startup & committed-use options for NovaAI

Thanks Olivia — this is super helpful. Based on the forecast and your target $/1M tokens, I put together two concrete options (high-level) and attached a draft quote: 

Option A — Startup track (preferred for Series A pilot)
- 6-month package: $25k credit applied to consumption over first 6 months + 40% off our standard unit price during that period.
- After credits, tiered pricing aligned to committed volumes or on-demand list if you opt out of commit.
- No minimum contract beyond agreeing to startup terms; procurement can sign the startup addendum.

Option B — Committed-use (recommended for GA ramp)
- 12-month commit with monthly minimums. Examples based on forecast:
  - Commit 1.5B tokens/month (12 months) => net ~$210 per 1M tokens (approx 30% off list).
  - Commit 3.5B tokens/month (12 months) => net ~$155 per 1M tokens (approx 45% off list).
- Multi-year (2 year) extension available for incremental ~5–10% additional discount.

Attached: proposed_committed_use_quote.pdf, startup_eligibility_form.docx

Next steps:
- Olivia / procurement: confirm whether you prefer Option A or B (or we can structure a hybrid: startup credit + short commit for GA)
- You: share any legal/payment constraints and confirm Monday 10am PT for procurement call
- Me: I'll update the quote with explicit $/1M numbers and DocuSign links for signatures once you pick a path

If your target is ~ $200/1M tokens net, Option B at ~1.5B/month commit would be close; Option A may make sense for the pilot to validate those economics.

Thanks — looping Laura on approvals and any exceptions.

Best,
Aditya

Attachments: proposed_committed_use_quote.pdf, startup_eligibility_form.docx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 13:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: startup & committed-use options for NovaAI

Aditya — quick internal: happy to approve up to 35% off list pricing for startup program customers (or up to 45% if they sign a 12-month committed-use). If they go for the 3.5B/month commit and 12–24 month term, we can consider an additional 5% multi-year incentive.

Please proceed with Option B draft and have legal prep the 12-month SOW template.

- Laura
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
